items.title: Magnarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2010
items.q: J.R. actually wrote down specific patterns for me to play. And he would tell me about my articulations, you know, like how to practice my articulations.

ctx.x: Isn’t there something to be said though for getting that inspiration and then finding out on your own?

Well yeah, and I think that he understood that aspect of it. And J.R. too. J.R. was very instrumental to me too, to my development too, and I would sit in with J.R. at the same time. And I would go to Sal’s house and then I would come back the next day and go to Utica College and play under J.R. J.R. was more of a mathematician. J.R. actually wrote down specific patterns for me to play. And he would tell me about my articulations, you know, like how to practice my articulations. And J.R. was more like a…
The times that you use those things you’re talking about, your sort of finger patterns or things that you know will work, is that because your mind is not telling you to do something else?
